name: Chile
hints: SII (Servicio de Impuestos Internos) 'Mapas' viewer and its backing services; IDE Chile (ide.cl / geoportal.cl CSW) catalogue for 'predios' / 'roles'; MINVU geoide.minvu.cl server folders (Valparaíso PREDIOS verified, list other regions' PREDIOS_* services); INE. Aim: a national or multi-region official predio layer. Two regions: Santiago and Concepción or Antofagasta.

name: Uruguay
hints: Dirección Nacional de Catastro (catastro.gub.uy) and the national IDE (ide.uy / geoservicios.ide.uy or visualizador.ide.uy): look for 'parcelario' WFS/WMS on the IDEuy GeoServer and the Catastro 'Sistema de Información Territorial'. We only found a bulk DXF. Two regions: Montevideo and Salto.

name: Colombia
hints: IGAC (igac.gov.co) 'Datos Abiertos Catastro' / 'Colombia en Mapas' (colombiaenmapas.gov.co) and the ArcGIS services behind it (geoportal.igac.gov.co / catastro ArcGIS REST); also ANT and SNC. IGAC hosts returned 500 before; retry with browser headers and inspect the Colombia en Mapas viewer JS for the FeatureServer. Bogotá, Medellín and Cali are verified municipal services. Two regions from a national service: e.g. Manizales and Barranquilla.

name: Peru
hints: GeoPerú / GeoIDEP (geoidep.gob.pe, geoperu.gob.pe) sat behind a Cloudflare challenge; SBN (Superintendencia Nacional de Bienes Estatales), COFOPRI 'Catastro' and municipal SAT/ICL Lima. Inspect GeoPerú's layer catalogue API for a 'predios'/'catastro' layer; also MINAGRI SICAR rural. Two regions: Lima and Arequipa.

name: Panama
hints: ANATI (anati.gob.pa) and the national IDE (IGN Tommy Guardia / IDE Panamá, ide.gob.pa?) plus Panama City's municipal geoportal (mupa.gob.pa). Look for a catastro WFS/ArcGIS endpoint. Two regions: Panama City and David.
